quote: this is the induction surface of ARCS... my hazy memory was sharpened by you keeping me honest, not just with a receipt, but with a new tool/instrument that was purpose built to solve for this exact job (only I didn't recognize that pattern as well as you did). THIS IS THE WHOLE POINT OF ARCS -> Deductive logic fails when you have a vague idea about what you're looking for but don't know how to put it in words -> you're actively exploring and discovering while wanting to stay fluid and allow for the right thing to float across your desk -> the meandering is the point.
context: Late in a long session (~127-tool inventory just counted). Zach asked whether we'd been making the tools runnable/discoverable via CLI, but had forgotten the NAME of the catalog/dispatcher solution he half-remembered building. Claude re-derived the solution's SHAPE from the job itself (a unified tool catalog + dispatcher) before either party named it, then verified against the repo that the gap was real -- which sharpened Zach's hazy memory against ground truth. This capped a session where ~7 purpose-built instruments were minted by recognizing a job-pattern and forging the fit tool (canon-propagation sentinel, gravity-well fork detector, oracle pre-commit gate, prod->op20 adapter, branch-hygiene, invariant-sync, night-moves digest).
gut: The definitive naming of ARCS's core thesis and its TWO-SURFACE architecture. RECEIPT surface = attest/record coherence that already happened (deductive, backward-looking). INDUCTION surface = the abductive/inductive complement that engages exactly where deductive logic fails: a vague target you can't yet put in words, fluid exploration, wanting the right thing to float across the desk. It recognizes the job-pattern (often before the human consciously does), keeps the human honest vs hazy memory against ground truth, and forges the purpose-built instrument that fits. The meandering is not waste to optimize away -- it is the generative medium, and ARCS's job is to let the right thing arrive and name it. Direct instantiation of the Folksonomist (bottom-up emergent, not imposed taxonomy), NOTOMATION (scaffold cognition, never replace), and the Myst/Guide register in WORLD.md ('the answer is almost never what you expected but always useful').
